steps.what: Read the posted sitting line before this nursing examination.
Compile, administer, and grade examinations, or assign this work to others.

tasks.design: The nursing instructor still compiles, administers and grades examinations, or assigns that work to others in the organisation. A sitting line is already posted in the {DOCS}, with course, sitting date, item count and the author's name, so the hunt for that sheet is shorter. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The sitting line sat on a paper sheet, so the instructor hunted it before the examination.
tasks.enabler_now: The course file already holds a sitting line. Showing course, sitting date, item count and the author's name is configuration of that file.
tasks.still_hard: How to compile the paper, run the sitting and grade the work is the instructor's judgement. A posted line does not mark a script.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor sees the sitting and refuses a line that does not name this examination.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the examination. Less time goes to hunting a sheet. The instructor still compiles, administers and grades.

reach.task: Post the sitting line before the examination.
reach.learn: The line needs course, sitting date, item count and the author's name, or the instructor reads the paper sheet.

reach.task: Sit the examination in the room.
reach.learn: The sitting is the instructor's own work in the room. It is not a send, and the student does not file a grade.

reach.task: Take a set of scripts when this instructor assigns that work.
reach.learn: Telling a colleague to mark is a talk inside the organisation. Filing the grade is not part of this task.

evidence.claim: Compiling, administering and grading examinations stays with the nursing instructor. A posted sitting line can be a shorter read. The sitting and the grading are not shorter. Model knowledge.
Annex III covers evaluating learning outcomes and detecting cheating in tests. This design does not evaluate by a model and does not detect cheating.
Emotion inference in education is banned. This design does not infer emotion during the sitting.
A grade set solely by a model is likely an automated decision about a person, and systematic automated evaluation needs a data-protection assessment. This design does not set a grade by a model.
Examiners appointed by the examination board set the result, and only that board sanctions fraud. The instructor grades by hand. This design does not set the result and does not sanction fraud.

The posted line is a course, a sitting date, an item count and an author's name. It is not a grade and not a patient record. National rules vary. The digest names the Netherlands for the education and data-protection laws.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is only compiling, administering and grading examinations, or assigning that work to others. Lecturing, writing materials and demonstrating patient care sit outside it. The examination officer posts the line before the sitting.

Structured input: one sitting line in the {DOCS} with course, sitting date, item count and the author's name. The line is the sitting, not a grade and not a patient record. If the line is missing or free text, the instructor reads the paper sheet and that read is not shorter.

The instructor still compiles, administers and grades in the room, or tells a colleague inside the organisation to mark a set. Nothing is recorded by a machine, sent, or committed. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. Filing a grade into the student record, or sending scripts outside the organisation, would be its own step, with a gate on the final version. That step is not in this design, and it is not folded into compiling, administering or grading. The prior that the sitting is a send outside the organisation is refused: it is the instructor's own examination in the room, and it is a write inside the organisation.

A model is not used. Closed-question marking, answer grouping and a proposed rubric score are not in this design. Existing system runtime is not the instructor's time. The design does not score a script, infer emotion, detect cheating, or file a grade. The in-person examination stays at full time.
unknowns: Whether this course file already has course, sitting date, item count and a name, or only a paper sheet.
Whether the site later wants a grade filed. This design does not file one.
research_questions: Who posts the sitting line, the examination officer or the instructor?
What share of sittings start with no line the instructor can read?

already_counted.description: Reading a missing or free-text sitting line by hand, inside the remaining read.

incremental.description: Checking that the sitting line still names this session and an author.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the sitting line is often missing or free text, so the instructor still hunts the paper sheet and the read is not shorter. High: most lines carry the named fields and an author's name, and only that hunt shrinks. The examination stays. The high stays under the net after the field check.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
